planets.name: HD 28109 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 28109 with a 22.9-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: HD 28109 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HD 28109. Its orbit and size follow Barone et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
